Q: What is the difference between authentication and authorization? A:

Authentication and authorization answer two different questions:

  • Authentication: "Who are you?"

  • Authorization: "What are you allowed to do?"

Real-world example

Think of entering an office building:

  1. You show your employee badge at reception. The system confirms that the badge belongs to you. That is authentication.

  2. You try to enter the server room. The system checks whether your employee account has permission to enter it. That is authorization.

You can be successfully authenticated as an employee but still not be authorized to enter every room.

What happens during login?

During the login process, the application usually:

  1. Receives your username and password.

  2. Verifies that the credentials belong to a valid user. This is authentication.

  3. Creates a session or token so that future requests know who you are.

Authorization normally happens afterward, whenever you attempt to access a protected page or perform an action. For example, the application may check whether you are an administrator before allowing you to delete another user.

So authorization is not necessarily performed only once during login. It may be checked on every protected request.

Q: What factors should I consider before choosing a Web Development Company? A:

If you're planning to get into web development in 2026, focus on technologies that are in high demand and give you strong career growth. Here's a structured roadmap:

1. Web Fundamentals (Must Learn)

  • HTML5

  • CSS3

  • Responsive Design (Flexbox, Grid)

  • JavaScript (ES6+)

  • TypeScript

2. Frontend Development

Choose one major framework:

  • React ⭐ (Most in-demand)

  • Angular

  • Vue.js

Also learn:

  • State Management (Redux Toolkit, Zustand, Pinia, etc.)

  • React Router / Vue Router

  • Component Design

  • API Integration (REST & GraphQL)

  • Form Handling and Validation

3. Styling

  • Tailwind CSS ⭐

  • Bootstrap

  • Material UI

  • Chakra UI

4. Backend Development

Pick one backend technology:

  • Node.js + Express.js ⭐

  • Java + Spring Boot

  • .NET

  • Python (Django/FastAPI)

5. Databases

  • PostgreSQL ⭐

  • MySQL

  • MongoDB

  • Redis (Caching)
